The text fixture consists only of the two selected original lines, preserving
spacing, line endings, names and marks. It is not the complete source document.

Published places are 1 and 2 although both displayed times are 14:13. The names
include the source's location text and truncation; no full identities are inferred.

Tests that change status, wind or timing fields are synthetic validation cases;
